title: SF7 Stacked Washer and Gas Dryer
sub: White, gas dryer, 3.5 and 7.0 cu. ft.
lead: A full-size Speed Queen pair in one cabinet, in white: a 3.5 cu. ft. front load washer beneath a 7.0 cu. ft. gas dryer, 26 7/8 inches wide. Both sets of controls sit in the center, where they can be reached. Backed for five years, parts and labor.

features.name: A full-size pair, one footprint
features.line: The washer holds 3.5 cu. ft. and the dryer 7.0, the same as Speed Queen's side-by-side front load pair. Controls for both are in the center of the cabinet.

features.name: Pet Plus, with a Flea cycle
features.line: Cycles made for pet bedding and blankets, and a Flea cycle that Speed Queen says it designed and tested for flea infestations.

features.name: Sanitize with Oxi, and steam
features.line: The washer's Sanitize with Oxi cycle works with an Oxi additive. The dryer answers with Steam Boost, Steam Refresh and Steam Sanitize.

features.name: Dynamic Balancing, 1,200 rpm
features.line: A variable-speed 1 HP motor spins up to 1,200 rpm, and Speed Queen's Dynamic Balancing keeps a heavy load in line while it does.

features.name: Five years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the SF7 with a 5-year warranty that covers parts and labor.

also: Dryer: 22,500 BTU gas burner; converts to LP with Speed Queen's kit, sold separately
Eleven washer cycles and ten dryer cycles
Moisture sensor with four auto dry cycles
Eco Dry and Anti-Static on the dryer
Stainless steel wash tub and outer tub
Up-front lint filter with a filter guard
